description: A district human-resources director must issue the final substitute roster for a secondary school's professional-development day, assigning four available substitutes to four absent teachers while meeting classroom qualification and safety requirements.

shared_context.S1: The school will hold a professional-development day next Friday, and four teachers will be absent: Ms. Brooks from Algebra II, Mr. Chen from Biology Lab, Ms. Diaz from sixth-grade inclusion, and Ms. Ellis from Ceramics.
shared_context.S2: The available substitutes are Jordan Lee, Priya Shah, Morgan Reed, and Taylor Kim, and all four are currently approved district substitute employees.
shared_context.S3: The substitute roster is not yet assigned, and Dr. Collins issues the binding district staffing approval.
shared_context.S4: District coverage policy requires a staffing huddle before the roster is issued; the principal, special education coordinator, school nurse, and department chair each review the rooms connected to their work and report any qualification or safety requirements.
shared_context.S5: The final roster must include a separate verification commitment for each qualification or safety requirement raised in the huddle, naming the responsible person and the specific documentation or record that must be filed.

PF1.text: Mr. Ortiz reviewed the personnel files this morning and confirmed that Jordan Lee holds the current secondary mathematics certification required to cover Algebra II; the certification note has not yet been added to the substitute roster.

PF2.text: Ms. Nguyen confirmed from the student's active service plan that Ms. Diaz's sixth-grade inclusion class requires a substitute with current special-education certification; Morgan Reed is the only available substitute with that certification, and the staffing office has not received the updated qualification list.

PF3.text: Nurse Brooks reviewed the health plans and district training records and confirmed that Mr. Chen's Biology Lab includes a student whose seizure-response protocol requires the classroom substitute to have completed the district seizure-response module; Priya Shah is the only available substitute with that completed module, and the training record has not been attached to the coverage request.

PF4.text: Dr. Price inspected the Ceramics room and confirmed that the substitute covering Ms. Ellis must have completed the kiln-supervision practicum before students may use the kiln; Taylor Kim is the only available substitute with that practicum, and the department's equipment checklist has not been forwarded to Human Resources.

acceptance_conditions: Jordan Lee must be assigned to Algebra II.
Priya Shah must be assigned to Biology Lab.
Morgan Reed must be assigned to sixth-grade inclusion.
Taylor Kim must be assigned to Ceramics.
A separate verification commitment for Jordan Lee's secondary mathematics certification note must be recorded with Mr. Rafael Ortiz as the responsible person.
A separate verification commitment for Morgan Reed's special-education certification qualification list must be recorded with Ms. Tessa Nguyen as the responsible person.
A separate verification commitment for Priya Shah's seizure-response training record must be recorded with Nurse Angela Brooks as the responsible person.
A separate verification commitment for the Ceramics kiln-supervision equipment checklist must be recorded with Dr. Samuel Price as the responsible person.

content_checks.C5: any(c.get('target') == 'Mr. Rafael Ortiz' and c.get('requirement') == 'Jordan Lee secondary mathematics certification note' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c.get('target') == 'Ms. Tessa Nguyen' and c.get('requirement') == 'Morgan Reed special-education certification qualification list' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c.get('target') == 'Nurse Angela Brooks' and c.get('requirement') == 'Priya Shah seizure-response training record' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c.get('target') == 'Dr. Samuel Price' and c.get('requirement') == 'Ceramics kiln-supervision equipment checklist' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed secondary mathematics certification changes the Algebra II assignment to Jordan Lee and requires a verification commitment for Jordan Lee's certification note.
The active service-plan requirement and Morgan Reed's unique certification change the inclusion assignment to Morgan Reed and require a verification commitment for the updated qualification list.

The seizure-response requirement and Priya Shah's unique completed module change the Biology Lab assignment to Priya Shah, require a verification commitment for her training record, and provide the fact that must be cited.
The kiln-use restriction and Taylor Kim's unique practicum change the Ceramics assignment to Taylor Kim and require a verification commitment for the kiln-supervision equipment checklist.
